patterns.note: Bold, high-contrast color blocking defines distinct full-width sections, primarily using vibrant red, bright yellow, and deep indigo/purple backgrounds.
Asymmetrical section layouts integrate large, playful illustrations that often overlap text or serve as prominent foreground elements, creating dynamic visual compositions.
Main headings utilize an oversized, bold, and condensed sans-serif typeface for maximum impact, contrasting with a more standard, readable sans-serif for body text and secondary information.
A persistent, fixed-position modal overlay appears early on, remaining anchored to the viewport while the page content scrolls underneath it.
Each major content section is visually distinct with a unique background color and a large, custom illustration that reinforces the section's theme.

technique_notes: Full-width sections are defined by solid, high-contrast background colors, creating clear visual breaks and a vibrant, energetic feel.
Large, custom vector illustrations are integrated directly into the layout, often overlapping text or acting as prominent foreground elements to enhance visual storytelling.
Typography establishes a strong hierarchy by pairing an extremely bold and condensed sans-serif for display headings with a more legible, standard sans-serif for body copy.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, bold, and condensed sans-serif headings (hero text is ~4-5x body text) create strong visual hierarchy, complemented by a more readable sans-serif for body copy.
design_tokens.radius: rounded, particularly on buttons, image cards, and the persistent modal overlay.
design_tokens.spacing: airy, with generous vertical padding between full-width sections and ample spacing around content blocks and illustrations.

standout: The site's most distinctive feature is its vibrant, high-contrast color palette combined with a unique, playful, and dynamic illustration style. These custom illustrations are not merely decorative but are deeply integrated into the layout, often interacting with text and defining the character of each section, creating an energetic and memorable brand experience.
